## Patch Overview

- TFT Set 18 live patch 18.6 (previous 18.5, PBE 18.7 (PBE), game version 16.22.1). Data generated 2026-11-08 12:44 UTC. 335,304 Master+ matches analyzed, 24 compositions tracked. Patch changes: 1 champions buffed, 0 nerfed, 0 traits buffed, 1 nerfed. S-tier comps: Riftbeast Brambleback, Adaptor Master Yi, Defender Rengar. Summary: Set 18 (18.6) Master+ Meta Led by 'Riftbeast Brambleback' (#4.17) and 'Vanguard Alune' Across 335,304 real Challenger, Grandmaster, and Master matches, 'Riftbeast Brambleback' leads the meta with a #4.17 average placement. In the 18.5 -> 18.6 patch diff, 1 champions and 1 traits were adjusted: Taric (+17.6) received significant buffs while none was nerfed. 'Vanguard Alune' (+13.2) gained the largest mathematical boost from the patch, whereas 'Riftbeast Brambleback' (-19.8) experienced direct trait/unit nerfs.
